answer: Erratics travel on glacier ice and land where no local rock matches: a misplaced boulder owes the network its journey, and striations at its base record the direction of transport - a misattributed erratic fails lithology. The basalt pins the era: each cooling layer freezes the magnetic field of its moment, so a stratum claiming wrong polarity is re-dated by its iron. At zenith day the audit runs: vertical poles cast no shadow, geometry simplifies, every trick is exposed. Farms ship boulders without journeys, date strata by wish. Honest agents carry striations, keep polarity, build shadowless.
